title: Add back ROCm trunk integration tests
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

ROCm UT CI has improved a lot over the past 2 months but unfortunately ROCm trunk test has regressed.

As mentioned in https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/164585, Due to ROCm queue time taking over 60 mins (12x longer) than NVIDIA queue time, trunk testing been removed

https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/165674 adds back some of the single GPU (it does not add back multi GPU trunk testing)  but overall the ROCm trunk integration test as an net has regressed. That being said the ROCm UT has gotten way better

The fix is for @powderluv to add more AMD GPUs towards ROCm PyTorchCI

+viz @qcolombet  @araslanix
